name: MemberRegistrationForm
title: Library Member Registration
description: Register as a new library member by providing your personal details and selecting a membership type

validation.message: First name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters
Last name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters
Please enter a valid email address
Please enter a valid phone number
Address must be between 10 and 200 characters
Please select a membership type
Please select a registration date

name: MembershipRenewalForm
title: Membership Renewal
description: Renew your library membership subscription and update your membership details

validation.message: Member ID must be in format: MEM12345
Renewal date must be today or a future date
Payment amount must be between $0 and $1000

Fulfillment date is required
Please select a status
Pickup deadline is required

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Add any additional notes about the fulfillment (e.g., special instructions, member contacted)

name: BookRegistrationForm
title: Register New Book
description: Add new books to the library catalog with complete bibliographic information and inventory details

validation.message: Book title is required and must be less than 200 characters
Author name is required
Please enter a valid ISBN number
Please select a category
Publisher name is required
Please enter a valid publication year between 1800 and 2025
Please enter a valid number of copies (1-999)
Shelf location is required

name: InventoryUpdateForm
title: Update Book Inventory
description: Modify book information, adjust copy counts, and update availability status

validation.message: Book ID must contain only uppercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
Title must be between 1 and 200 characters
Author name must be between 1 and 100 characters
Total copies must be between 0 and 1000
Available copies must be between 0 and 1000
Location must be between 1 and 50 characters

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Add any additional notes or comments about this inventory update

validation.message: Notes cannot exceed 500 characters

name: FinePaymentForm
title: Process Fine Payment
description: Record fine payment from member for overdue books

validation.message: Fine ID must be in format FINE-XXXXX
Member ID must be in format MEM-XXXXX
Amount must be between $0.01 and $10,000
Payment date is required

name: FineWaiverForm
title: Fine Waiver Request
description: Form for librarians to waive or reduce fines with justification and approval

validation.message: Please enter a valid fine ID
Amount must be greater than or equal to 0
Amount must be greater than or equal to 0

fields.name: waiverReason
fields.label: Justification for Waiver
fields.placeholder: Provide detailed reason for waiving or reducing the fine (e.g., system error, special circumstances, member hardship)

validation.message: Justification must be between 20 and 500 characters
Please enter the approver's name

name: CheckoutForm
title: Book Checkout
description: Process book checkout by selecting member, scanning book ISBN, and confirming checkout details

validation.message: Please select a member
Please enter a valid ISBN (10-13 digits)
Please select checkout date
Please select due date

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Add any special notes or conditions (optional)

validation.message: Notes must not exceed 500 characters

name: ReturnForm

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Add any additional notes about the return (damage details, member comments, etc.)

validation.message: Notes must not exceed 500 characters
